scope: Audit of supplied manifest files and timing rows pasted into the conversation; not a replay or full snapshot correctness audit

recorded_environment.measurementBoundary: Spring useCase.execute including transaction commit; excludes fixture setup, external validation and file IO; no HTTP

limitations: Dirty working trees: HEAD alone does not identify the full executed source state.
Only recorded files are covered by hash comparison; numeric comparison helper and its tests were not in sourceSha256.
No independent revalidation of per-run assignment/schedule snapshots was performed in this audit.
Source hashes and environment metadata are supplied measurements, not independently collected from the workstation.
No extrapolation to HTTP, concurrent load, all event sizes or unimplemented eligibility/category rules.
